logs.title: Night 1, or Tuesday
logs.text:
Night 1 after. Or Tuesday. The clock says Tuesday.
We were halfway through the gate when every light on the ship blinked and came back different.
Dunn says the stars are in the wrong places. Dunn is the navigator, so I told him that's his job.
He didn't laugh. We have 41 days of food and 90 of coffee. Coffee wins.

logs.title: Incident Report (Minor)
logs.text:
OFFICIAL LOG, CS-203 CONSTANCY. Gate transit interrupted at 02:14 ship time.
Cause: unknown. Cause (provisional): solar event. Cause (privately): the helmsman says 'it let go'.
Crew of 31. Vessel intact. Position: not on any chart I possess.
Filing this under 'Incidents, Minor'. I will not be sending a copy. There is nobody to send it to.

logs.title: Eleven seconds
logs.text:
The door was open for eleven seconds.
We saw through it. Do not ask what. The word we have is 'enough'.
Then it closed, and we were told that was the Snap.
We were not told. We were there.

logs.title: Boneyard run, third gate
logs.text:
Boneyard run, third gate side. Spotted a ship coming OUT of the gate. Not through. Out.
Green running lights, hull like it was poured instead of built. Nothing on any channel.
Hobb says wave. I didn't wave. Nobody on board moved.
It drifted past us like a dog that knows the way home, and went nowhere. We left. Fast.

logs.title: Contact, unregistered
logs.text:
Contact 0.4 AU off Gate 2. Hull composition inconsistent with any registry.
Systems running. No crew detected. Requested orders.
No reply. Requested orders again.
Logged the first silence as 'delay'. Logged the second as 'concern'. Logging the third as 'the usual'.

logs.title: Not ships
logs.text:
They are not ships. They are sentences the gate has not finished.
We have asked to hear the end.
The Warden says no. The Warden is shy.
We will wait. We are good at it.

logs.title: Read the small print
logs.text:
Ma Gantry sent a bill along with my hull. The bill is bigger than the hull.
I looked it up: that's allowed. It's in the small print, which is also the big print.
I have decided to be a legend instead.
Ma says legends pay the same rates.

logs.title: Form 9-B, Requisitions
logs.text:
To whoever reads this: the shipyard at Meridian is still working. We make Mk parts.
We have nothing to put them on.
I have drafted 2,400 requisitions this year and approved every one.
If a ship ever comes, we will be ready.

logs.title: Experiment 4411
logs.text:
Experiment 4411. The gate answered the test pulse before we sent it.
Mira says it is a timing fault. Mira has been saying that for nine weeks.
Today it answered twice.
We have not told the Concord. We have not told anyone. We have told the gate, and it did not seem surprised.

logs.title: Dues
logs.text:
They threw me out for creative accounting. The Fang took me in for the same reason.
We're all exiles. Ma threw us out, Concord hunts us, and the Lumen won't even talk.
It's a good club. The dues are terrible.

logs.title: Gate-yard roster
logs.text:
Gate-yard roster, labour caste, Basalt: 4,100 hands before the Snap.
Count after the Snap: 4,100. I counted twice.
They all remember that night. None of them will say what they remember.
Every one of them, when they think I'm not looking, looks at the same patch of sky.

logs.title: Rule of the Rusthold
logs.text:
Welded three hulls together today, joined by a corridor made from a fourth.
Tomorrow I find out which way is up.
Rule of the Rusthold: if it holds air, it's a room.
If it doesn't, it's a balcony.

logs.title: The count
logs.text:
We counted the stars on the first night. There were 3,011.
On the second night there were 3,012.
We do not know which one is the new one.
We have decided to be kind to all of them.

logs.title: To Dorrie
logs.text:
To Dorrie, wherever you landed.
The jump put me in the Drift and you somewhere else, and I check every wreck for your hat.
It's a green hat. If you find this, it's a green hat.
If it isn't, ignore me. I'm still looking.

logs.title: Patrol log, no action
logs.text:
Stopped a Scrapper barge for an unlicensed reactor.
Reactor was fine. Barge was named Probably Fine.
I wrote 'Probably Fine' in the findings box and let them go.
Please do not review this.

logs.title: Unit 7
logs.text:
Warden unit 7 has begun asking questions.
The first was: who is on the other side of the gate?
It is an unscheduled behaviour. We are delighted.
We are also keeping its door locked from the outside.

logs.title: To whoever salvages my ship
logs.text:
WARNING TO WHOEVER SALVAGES MY SHIP: the third cabin is not empty.
It has my brother-in-law. Not in the grim way. He just won't leave.
Feed him. He likes the blue ration.
He doesn't like questions.

logs.title: Meridian, day 3
logs.text:
Do Not Panic signs are up on every deck. Panic has not been made available.
We are all waiting for instructions from the Lattice Authority.
The Lattice Authority was the Lattice.

logs.title: Gate three
logs.text:
The crystals at gate three are not growing. They are being remembered.
If you can hear the second note, put the shard back.
If you can hear the third, it is already too late to be polite about it.

logs.title: A kettle
logs.text:
Skipper's log. A Hollow tried to dock with us.
Airlock cycled itself open. Nobody inside, lights on, kettle still hot.
We closed the door. Took the kettle.
It's the best kettle we've ever had. It never boils over. Not sure that's good news.
